name: Thousand Years
overview: Scripture reveals that a thousand years in God's sight is like a fleeting moment, emphasizing His eternal nature and sovereignty (Psalms 90:4). The book of Revelation describes a future period where Christ reigns with His faithful followers for a thousand years, a time marked by resurrection and judgment (Revelation 20:4-5). This thousand-year reign highlights the victorious rule of Christ and the vindication of those who remain faithful to Him.
